 "topology": "3-stage current-starved ring with mirrored NMOS/PMOS starving, resistor floor current, 2-inverter output buffer",
 "rationale": "Ring power is about N*C*VDD^2*f. With N=3 and C of about 18 fF that gives roughly 300 uW at 1.1 GHz. The two bias branches run at I_s/K (K=7), about 75 uW. The buffer adds about 60 uW, so the total is about 440 uW. VCTRL near Vth (0.6 V) would starve the ring almost completely, so a resistor sets a floor current. That keeps f_lo measurable while fmax/fmin stays well above 3. The buffer restores a rail-to-rail swing into the 10 fF load."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I_s":    (150e-6, 60e-6, 300e-6),   # stage starving current at mid VCTRL
    "K":      (7.0, 3.0, 12.0),          # mirror ratio stage/reference
    "ffl":    (0.25, 0.08, 0.5),         # floor-current fraction of reference at mid
    "Lr":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),          # VCTRL reference NMOS length
    "Lm":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),          # mirror (starver) length
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),          # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "gmid_n": (7.0, 5.0, 12.0),          # NMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Wn_inv": (0.8, 0.42, 2.0),          # ring inverter NMOS width (L=0.15)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vlo, vhi = spec["vctrl_range"]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    N = 3
    K = p["K"]
    I_s = p["I_s"]
    I_ref = I_s / K
    I_fl = p["ffl"] * I_ref
    I_mref = I_ref - I_fl

    # --- bias: PMOS diode, VCTRL NMOS + resistor floor
    pd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lm"], I_ref, vds=1.0)
    pb = vdd - pd.vgs
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["Lr"], vmid, max(pb, 0.2))
    Wref = max(0.42, I_mref / max(o1["Id"], 1e-12))
    Rfl = max(1e3, pb / I_fl)
    # replica branch -> NMOS diode
    nd = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Lm"], I_ref, vds=0.6)
    # stage starvers (same L and gm/Id, K x current)
    ps = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lm"], I_s, vds=0.4)
    ns = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Lm"], I_s, vds=0.4)

    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]; Wp = 2.0 * Wn; Li = 0.15
    # buffer
    Wb1n, Wb1p = 0.42, 0.84
    Wb2n, Wb2p = 1.0, 2.0

    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", pd)
    n.M("MREF", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wref, p["Lr"])
    n.R("RFL", "pb", "vss", Rfl)
    n.dev("MPC", "nb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", pd)
    n.dev("MND", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", nd)
    for i in range(N):
        a = "r%d" % i; b = "r%d" % ((i + 1) % N)
        n.dev("MPS%d" % i, "sp%d" % i, "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ps)
        n.M("MPI%d" % i, b, a, "sp%d" % i, "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Li)
        n.M("MNI%d" % i, b, a, "sn%d" % i, "vss", "nfet", Wn, Li)
        n.dev("MNS%d" % i, "sn%d" % i, "nb", "vss", "vss", ns)
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wb1p, Li)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb1n, Li)
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wb2p, Li)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb2n, Li)

    # --- predictions
    def cg(dev, W):
        return lut.op(dev, W, Li, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    c_inv = cg("n", Wn) + cg("p", Wp)
    c_node = 1.6 * c_inv + 1e-15
    c_node_avg = c_node + (cg("n", Wb1n) + cg("p", Wb1p)) / N
    eta = 0.6

    def i_stage(vc):
        pbx = pb if vc >= vmid else min(vdd - 0.85, pb + 0.2)
        o = lut.op("n", Wref, p["Lr"], vc, max(pbx, 0.15))
        return K * (o["Id"] + pbx / Rfl)

    def f_of(vc):
        return eta * i_stage(vc) / (N * c_node_avg * vdd)

    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = f_of(vlo), f_of(vmid), f_of(vhi)
    c_buf = cg("n", Wb2n) + cg("p", Wb2p) + 0.6 * (cg("n", Wb2n) + cg("p", Wb2p)) + cl
    p_ring = N * c_node_avg * vdd ** 2 * f_mid
    p_buf = (c_buf + 2e-15) * vdd ** 2 * f_mid * 1.3
    p_bias = 2 * I_ref * vdd
    power = p_ring + p_buf + p_bias
    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
               "swing": 1.75, "power": power}
```
